martridge.voice_description: An old wizard, small in stature but vain about his power: reedy, precise, theatrical, a touch pompous, quick to take offence and to boom when angered. Elderly, dry, slightly crackly, clear diction.
martridge.preview_text: I am a great magician. I am nothing of the sort! You cannot measure magic by size! Of course I am.. just not physically. If you would like to learn more.. Come to my hidden cabin. Good point. It lies behind some trees north-east of here. DON'T ANGER ME, HUMAN!

milder.voice_description: A young man of about twenty, the village bully: big, smug and slow-drawling, mocking and pleased with himself, with a braying laugh. Deeper and more confident than the hero he taunts, small-town American.
milder.preview_text: Well, lookie what we got here. Nothing. 'cept to watch you work... Is pig farming fun? Are you feeding pigs right now? Bawahahahah! See you around, squirt.

mother.voice_description: A middle-aged farm mother: brisk, dry and warm underneath, unimpressed by her son's nonsense, quick with a put-down. Plain small-town American, medium pitch, unhurried, a little tired.
mother.preview_text: Dink, it's getting late! No food until you feed the pigs! Dink, can you do something for me? Can you go out to the woods and see if you can get, some AlkTree nuts, I think they're in season. You're a dear. That's very amusing, Dink. You get the sack of feed, and you sprinkle it in the pig pen. And don't tease them! You'll get over it. Good boy. Go visit our neighbors while I prepare dinner.

king.voice_description: A king in late middle age: warm, resonant and formal, genial and amused, used to being obeyed, grave when the news is bad. Measured pace, rounded vowels, a mild old-fashioned courtly manner.
king.preview_text: Hello, Dink. I've heard much about you - it is good to finally meet you. Now what is it I can help you with? Ahh, the famous Dink Smallwood sense of humor I heard so much about! You Dink? It is suicide. And I cannot refuse you. Go north from this castle until you hit the cliffs. I will have men there to guide you through the passage. SMALLWOOD HAS RETURNED! Hooray! The world is safe!

dink.voice_description: A young man, a pig farmer's son of about eighteen who insists he is a warrior: cocky, sarcastic, quick to sulk, with a plain small-town American accent. Energetic and a little nasal, comic timing, not heroic.
dink.preview_text: I'm NOT a pig farmer. Boy? Please refer to me as warrior from now on. Hey, that's Lyna with Milder Flatstomp! I HATE that guy! Why must I attack furniture? Smells damp in here. I don't like this one bit... This cave sucks, let's leave... WATER MUST DIE!

seth.voice_description: An ancient, inhuman sorcerer: deep, slow and resonant, calm and contemptuous, every word deliberate, with a cold amusement that breaks into a furious roar. Ageless, sepulchral, slightly unnatural, as if speaking from a great hall.
seth.preview_text: I am the beginning and the end. I am everything you love. I am everything you despise. FEEL MY WRATH, SMALLWOOD! MOTHER!!!!!!!!!!

mog.voice_description: A goblin king: huge, guttural and gravelly, slow and proud, grieving then enraged. Deep chest voice with a rough growl under it, deliberate, booming when he shouts, clearly a monster but fluent and regal.
mog.preview_text: Who dares wake the mighty Mog, king of Goblins? Of course. I was raised by.. what is this? My comrades litter the ground! You? YOU? I MUST AVENGE MY BROTHERS!

woman_old.voice_description: Elderly woman, quavering, fussy and sentimental, a little nosy and fond of a drink, breaking into hysterical grief.
woman_old.preview_text: You must keep searching for Quackers!  I loved him! Hello murderer!! I'm so grateful to you, Dink!  You are wonderful! It's not your fault Dink. Oh Dink, look who is here!
woman_old.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

guard.voice_description: Adult man in uniform, stolid and professional, a touch amused or wary, shouting when provoked.
guard.preview_text: Sorry about what happened Dink, I hope you're ok. Dink is a hero!  WE MUST GO TELL THE OTHERS! King Daniel has ruled with an iron hand for nearly a decade now.
guard.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

man_middle.voice_description: Ordinary middle-aged man, an all-purpose voice that runs from tired and polite to gruff, anxious or angry.
man_middle.preview_text: Actually, it was to stop a freak named Bishop Nelson. Guards!! Help me, destroy this madman! But they say a magic user came and cast a mighty spell on the castle.
man_middle.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

man_old.voice_description: Elderly man with a weathered, gravelly voice, cranky and rambling, a tall-tale teller or ex-sailor who has had a drink.
man_old.preview_text: Did I ever tell you about the time I trained a slayer? He's a PIG FARMER?! I suppose I'll be dead soon.  I'm not particularly worried. Nope.  If I did, I doubt I would want to live it.
man_old.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

woman_young.voice_description: Young adult woman, bright, direct and spirited, able to turn sharp, sorrowful or tearful.
woman_young.preview_text: Oh yes!  Hey, hero Smallwood just asked me out! You fool, of course not!!  He doesn't do that!! Nothing Dink, you wouldn't understand. There was nothing you could do..
woman_young.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

merchant.voice_description: Shopkeeper of either sex, polite and practical, with smug or prim sales patter that turns meek when struck.
merchant.preview_text: That hurts and all, but you could be doing much more damage with a bow! I'm sorry sir, but you DON'T have enough gold! Um, sir?  It's stuffed.  It isn't alive... It won't hurt you.
merchant.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

monster.voice_description: Deep, slow, growling beast that speaks in words through a snarl, menacing and boastful.
monster.preview_text: Try your best but you risk your life doing so... Who dares enter my cave? You cannot win, Smallwood. RRrrr ar a rar a  arrgghhh. I sense someone in my domain.
monster.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

duck.voice_description: Comic talking duck, deadpan and friendly, with a slight quacking nasal cadence, ranging from sulky to hearty.
duck.preview_text: Hi, we are the giant ducks of Koka Isle. Quack.  No!! To bad, better luck next time. The bets are in, let's fight! Would you like to play with me? Too bad, better luck next time.
duck.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

traveller.voice_description: Friendly middle-aged wanderer, chatty and relaxed, a natural lore-giver who explains things at length in a warm storytelling tone.
traveller.preview_text: AlkTree nuts??  Those make for a hearty meal.  Let's see.. Ow, crazy bastard!! If you ever run into goblins, be careful. So young man, what's your name?
traveller.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

zands.voice_description: Man in his thirties, jumpy and informal, an escaped prisoner who talks a lot, dry and bitter about goblins, with lore delivered in long rambling explanations.
zands.preview_text: I hope I can make it to PortTown and get away for a while. Anyway they said this guy could actually turn people to ice!! I've always wanted to go out into the world and find adventure.
zands.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

narrator.voice_description: Neutral, clear storyteller or reader voice for signs, posters and end-card text, warm, slightly wry and unhurried.
narrator.preview_text: Or make your own, download the free development kit. YOU HAVE FINISHED THE GAME. By order of our great ducks the monthly tax shall be doubled. The King's News, issue 76.
narrator.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

girl.blocked: ElevenLabs refused the voice-design prompt (safety guidelines: a child voice). Proposal: cast the girls with the woman_young voice, or decide a different approach with the owner.
girl.voice_description: Young girl of about six to ten, high and bright, by turns chirpy and gossipy, innocent, frightened or spoiled and screeching.
girl.preview_text: Libby and her new boyfriend seem really happy together. He's a slayer shapeshifter!  No!!!! I think the Carcass would appreciate another sacrifice, Bishop Nelson.

christina.voice_description: Young woman, earnest and sunny, a painter and the Mayor's daughter, polite, a little dreamy, urgent when the town is in danger.
christina.preview_text: Yeah me too, everyone's happy as can be. I'll head back to the fountain and warn people. My god, look at this plan. The mayor's sometimes in here. Not really, no one's been here.
christina.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

nelson.voice_description: Smooth, theatrical middle-aged cult leader, unctuous and sermonizing, with a gleeful cruelty underneath.
nelson.preview_text: Your blood will flow like the river Jordan. The girls are hungry - DINNER TIME! How goes the Dead Dragon Carcass worshipping, girls? Judgement day has cometh, sinner!
nelson.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

villain.voice_description: Cold, rough-voiced men of a criminal conspiracy, sneering and threatening, with short bursts of cruel laughter.
villain.preview_text: You may live, if you forget all that you've seen here. Looks like you have trouble learning, small one. I thought I told you to stay away from us. Right.  Have you contacted Mog?
villain.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

man_young.voice_description: Young adult man, casual, energetic and slightly deadpan or hyperactive, an everyman.
man_young.preview_text: There go my chances of impressing the Mayor's daughter!!!! My ducks!!!!!!!! ALL DEAD!!!!!!! DAMN YOU! I don't know man, I just work here. What are you, some kind of freak?
man_young.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

woman_middle.voice_description: Middle-aged woman, warm, worn and practical, alternating anxious motherly softness with fear or resolve.
woman_middle.preview_text: This must be a hard time for you, being so young and suffering... Not the fists, not the fists!! It's in the King's News, there is a copy at the healers.
woman_middle.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

wizard_old.voice_description: Very old, absent-minded mage, dry and rambling, forgetful with names, muttering ancient lore.
wizard_old.preview_text: Why should I care what happens to this man? SMALLWOOD ?!? Well, if those Cast members are involved I'd best help. Thank you ... what is your name friend?
wizard_old.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

ghost.voice_description: Eerie spectral adult voice, hollow and echoing, flat and plaintive, then shrieking.
ghost.preview_text: Last thing I remember is that group of knights.. and blood. LOOK UPON MY DEFORMED FACE! I feel so old.. yet why have I not aged? Some of us like to eat humans.  I would leave if I were you.
ghost.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

tree.voice_description: Creaky, comical talking tree, timid and nasal, fond of puns and a cackling laugh.
tree.preview_text: Please sir, don't hurt me, the talking tree of the east! Your magic is treely useless against me.. HAW HAW HAW! There is a rock near the Duck Idol with a crack in it...
tree.chosen_by: owner (picks given in chat, saved by Claude)

goblin.blocked: ElevenLabs refused the voice-design prompt (safety guidelines), most likely the gibberish preview text. Proposal: cast the goblins with the Mog voice (qpvaboJ8HxkAt3kkxRCj), or decide another approach with the owner.
goblin.voice_description: Gruff, guttural goblins; most lines are invented gibberish to be read as an alien language with consistent sounds, and a few are childlike broken English.
goblin.preview_text: Hoglim dack byork! Oston tewers inat'l meen o mistary! Gro'k ki owab dakis gedi! no bow?!!! un not joon! leev!! they ar BAD.  they can oonly anderstund ONE theng.

dragon.not_designed: only two lines (46 characters), below the design tool minimum of 100. Proposal: cast the dragons with the monster voice (k23dThXtPDcDOatu0rEY).
dragon.voice_description: Vast, ancient dragon, a low rumbling slow voice, solemn and vengeful.
dragon.preview_text: Let us finish it. Run from us no more, humans.
